active.rules:
If the highest hourly total system load reported for the ERCOT grid on October 30, 2026 is above 

54,000 MW, then the market resolves to Yes.
active.resolution:
The Expiration Value is the highest value in the TOTAL column of the first complete “Actual System Load by Forecast Zone” CSV report published by ERCOT for the October 30, 2026 operating day.

Each value represents ERCOT system load for the corresponding full hour. Instantaneous load readings displayed elsewhere by ERCOT will not be considered.

Values will be compared as published without rounding. Later revisions, settlement adjustments, or republications will not affect the Expiration Value.

methodology: Brier scores use the first two-sided quote captured in each 09, 12, 15 or 18 Central Time hour, before market close, for settled markets. Midpoints describe market probabilities, not guaranteed fills. Contract counts within a day are correlated. Settled peaks are Kalshi expiration values. Forecast peaks use source-issued pre-midnight ERCOT forecasts; prior capture is shown separately.
